name.value: Greater Victoria Public Library - Bruce Hutchison Branch

description.value: The Bruce Hutchison Branch is a full-service public library branch of the Greater Victoria Public Library system, located on Elk Lake Drive adjacent to Elk Lake Regional Park—a hub for cycling, running, and paddling in the Capital Regional District. As a public institution, it provides free access to books, digital resources, and public computers in a climate-controlled setting. Its position along a well-used cycling corridor makes it a natural potential waypoint for touring and recreational cyclists passing through Saanich.
